desc: chop GOTO leg (own navigator; Baritone removed) — chop reuses scan+navigation+mine. A 3-tall oak trunk at x12 on a flat floor; bot at x0. scan finds the log (LOG_FOUND), greedy GOTO walks the ~12 blocks to it, MINE fells it. PASS = LOG_FOUND with no ERROR; the GOTO→MINE walk + brokenCount are confirmed via the journal afterward (mine emits no log event).
